content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00122 For intra-partition communication with incoherent implicit dataWriteAccess no write-back copy actions to a global RTE-buffer will be performed, if the involved runnables are all running in one preemption area. In this case the DataWriteCom- pletedEvent shall be fired after the termination of the last sending runnable in the sending task/ISR2. The transmission status shall be RTE_E_TRANSMIT_ACK and can be collected with Rte_IFeedback API.
